title: Vendor SRD 5.1 PDF source artifact and record provenance
description: Vendor the approved D&D SRD 5.1 PDF/source artifact so D&D importer coverage and exact-name validation can be derived from a pinned authoritative source rather than hand-curated lists. Record source provenance, license metadata, retrieval details, and checksum information. Keep this bead focused on source artifact policy and deterministic source availability; do not expand parser behavior or implement the exact creature name-set check here.
acceptance_criteria:
- Approved SRD 5.1 PDF/source artifact is placed under packages/core/sources/dnd5e-srd-5.1/ or the repo's chosen deterministic source-artifact location.
- Source README/manifest records exact source URL, license, version, retrieval date, and checksum/hash.
- Importer/source tooling can locate the vendored artifact deterministically.
- Documentation explains why the PDF is vendored and how it supports coverage/audit validation.
- No parser behavior is expanded except minimal path/source wiring needed to recognize the vendored artifact.
- No hand-curated monster list is added.
- npm run check and relevant tests pass.
notes: Review round 1 addressed in commit e34d005 / PR #127: (1) attribution text replaced with verbatim SRD 5.1 PDF preamble quote in manifest.json (attribution.text) and source-dir README; (2) sourceDate corrected from 2023-01-12 to 2023-01-27 (Wizards' CC-BY-4.0 release announcement) with sourceDateNote pinning the field's semantics; (3) packages/core/test/srdSourceArtifact.test.ts added — reads manifest, stats PDF, asserts size + SHA-256 match. Verified failure mode by mutating the pinned hash. License URL upgraded to /legalcode to match preamble. Follow-up bd bnb tracks aligning the pack-level attributionText with the verbatim preamble (separate scope: importer emit change).
close_reason: PR #127 merged. Vendored SRD 5.1 PDF with SHA-256 pin, source manifest, README, and srdSourceArtifact test. Review fixes (verbatim date, legalcode URL, attribution object) landed in same PR.
